The config file is `config.json` in the gournal home folder. These keys are supported.

| Key | Type | Default | Validation | Description |
|-----|------|---------|------------|-------------|
| `deviceId` | string | Generated on first run | A non-empty string. Any other value stops gournal with an error. | Gournal generates this stable id for the machine. Do not change it. |
| `weekStartsOn` | integer | 1 | An integer from 0 to 6. Other values give a warning and the default. | The first day of the week, from 0 (Sunday) to 6. The `--week` option uses it. |
| `projectAliases` | Record<string, string> | {} | An object of strings. An alias chain is an error: if `a` maps to `b`, then `b` must not be a key in the same map. | Maps an old project name to the name to use, for example `{ "old-name": "new-name" }`. |
| `tagAliases` | Record<string, string> | {} | An object of strings. An alias chain is an error: if `a` maps to `b`, then `b` must not be a key in the same map. | Maps an old tag to the tag to use, for example `{ "bugfix": "bug" }`. |
| `ticketPrefixes` | string[] | [] | An array of strings. Any other value stops gournal with an error. | Lists ticket prefixes, for example `["SBDC", "PLAT"]`. A tag that looks like a ticket becomes a Jira ref only when its prefix is in this list. |
| `staleAfterDays` | integer | 14 | A positive integer. Other values give a warning and the default. | The age in days after which an open blocker or next item counts as stale. |
| `github.autoSync` | boolean | true | true or false. Other values give a warning and the default. | Turns on auto-sync of GitHub activity. |
| `github.autoSyncMinutes` | integer | 15 | A positive integer. Other values give a warning and the default. | The number of minutes that auto-sync waits between syncs. |
| `github.initialSyncDays` | integer | 30 | A positive integer. Other values give a warning and the default. | The number of days of GitHub activity that the first sync reads. |
| `github.owners.include` | string[] | [] | An array of strings. Other values give a warning and an empty list. | Limits the sync to these owners (users or organizations). |
| `github.owners.exclude` | string[] | [] | An array of strings. Other values give a warning and an empty list. | Skips these owners (users or organizations) in the sync. |
